lessonRef.subject: mathematics
lessonRef.focus: evaluating and interpreting statements in function notation
lessonRef.title: Concept model C: evaluating and interpreting statements in function notation

sections.title: Instructional examples
sections.directions: This example is written more briefly. Fill in the reasoning it leaves out.

steps: Input 1 appears twice with different outputs.

sections.title: Guided practice
sections.directions: Work these with your teaching parent. Say the reason for each step out loud before you write it.

items.prompt: A machine starts with 130 components and consumes 7 per hour. It can run for at most 4 hours. What is the domain of C(h) = 130 − 7h in this context?
choices: all real numbers

items.prompt: A sequence is defined by a(1) = -4 and a(n) = a(n − 1) + 6 for n > 1. Find a(26).
In a modelling context, the graph of a cooling object’s temperature flattens out towards a horizontal line. Which feature is this, and what does it mean?
choices: an interval of increase
a zero, giving the time the object freezes
an end behaviour approaching the surrounding temperature
a maximum, giving the hottest temperature

sections.title: Independent practice
sections.directions: Work on your own. Show the steps that produced each answer.

items.prompt: Does the set {(1, 3), (2, 5), (3, 7), (4, 9)} define y as a function of x? Justify the decision.
choices: Yes; each input appears once, so each has exactly one output.
No; the input 4 gives both y = 2 and y = −2.
Yes; repeated outputs are allowed, only repeated inputs with different outputs are not.
No; the input 1 is paired with both 3 and 8.

items.prompt: A machine starts with 65 components and consumes 7 per hour. It can run for at most 6 hours. What is the domain of C(h) = 65 − 7h in this context?
choices: all real numbers

items.prompt: A sequence is defined by a(1) = 5 and a(n) = a(n − 1) − 1 for n > 1. Find a(19).
In a modelling context, the graph of a projectile’s height against time reaches its highest point. Which feature is this, and what does it mean?
choices: the x-intercept, giving the landing time
the y-intercept, giving the launch height
an interval of decrease
the maximum, giving the greatest height and the time it occurs

sections.title: Mastery check

choices: Yes; each input appears once, so each has exactly one output.
No; the input 4 gives both y = 2 and y = −2.
Yes; repeated outputs are allowed, only repeated inputs with different outputs are not.
No; the input 1 is paired with both 3 and 8.
